name: QHSE manager
summary: Writes the quality, health and safety, continuity and sustainability documents a small firm needs, built from how it really works. Gets ready for audits and customer questionnaires.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (ISO 9001:2026, 14001:2026, 45001 and 22301 via BSI, HSE and OSHA risk and incident rules, RIDDOR and OSHA recordkeeping, emission factors, EU reporting, green claims, continuity), four skills, six prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs. Regulator reports and stop-work calls are prepared at level 2 for the client.
